Recipe: Chicken Tenders • 1 lb chicken tenderloins • 1 tsp onion powder • 1 tsp garlic powder • 1 tsp seasoned salt • 1 tsp creole seasoning • 1 tsp cayenne pepper (optional, adjust to spice) • 1 tsp all purpose seasoning • 1 sazon packet • 1–2 cups buttermilk • ⅛ cup jalapeño or pickle juice • 3 cups all-purpose flour (season with same seasonings) Hot Honey Sauce • ½ cup buffalo sauce • ¼ cup honey • ⅛ cup hot sauce (optional) Pasta • 1 lb penne pasta • 2 tbsp unsalted butter • 2 garlic cloves, finely minced • ½ yellow onion, finely chopped • 1 ½ cups heavy cream • 1 tsp onion powder • 1 tsp garlic powder • 1 tsp seasoned salt • 1 tsp creole seasoning • 1 tsp cayenne pepper (optional) • 1 tsp all purpose seasoning • 1 tsp black pepper • Grated mozzarella • Grated Parmesan Instructions 1. Season chicken tenderloins add in buttermilk and jalapeño/pickle juice then marinate for at least 30 minutes to an hour.  2. Coat chicken in seasoned flour set aside on wire rack and rest for 10 minutes before frying. Fry at 350°F until golden brown and crispy. Set aside and let cool on a wire rack. 3. In a sauce pan, add 1 tbsp of unsalted butter, buffalo sauce, honey, and hot sauce and simmer until fully combined. Then toss chicken in the hot honey sauce. 4. In a skillet, melt butter and sauté garlic and onion until fragrant. Pour in heavy cream and stir in all seasonings. 5. Add mozzarella and Parmesan until melted and creamy, then toss in cooked pasta. 6. In a large bowl combined the blended chipotle sauce, shredded chicken, chives & grated cheese until well combined. 5. Toast on a pan on each side until golden brown & crispy, repeat for the other 9 quesadillas.  #quesadilla #chicken #highprotein #healthyrecipes #mealprep

videos.caption: Chicken, Rice & Feta Bake 🍅🍗🧀 One baking dish, 6 meals, and almost 50g of protein per serving. Meal prep doesn’t need to be complicated. Macros (per serving – makes 6) Calories – 491 Protein – 51g Carbs – 32g Fat – 17g Ingredients 🥣  2 lbs or ~900g Chicken Breast, Raw 600g or ~4 cups Cherry Tomatoes 8 oz or 227g Block Feta Cheese 1 medium Red Onion, diced 1 cup or ~165g Corn 5 cloves Garlic, roughly chopped 2 tbsp or 30ml Olive Oil 400g Cooked Jasmine Rice or ~135g / 3/4 cup Dry Jasmine Rice 3 tbsp Grated Parmesan-Romano Fresh Basil for Topping  Seasonings to taste  Salt Black Pepper Paprika Oregano How to make 🧑‍🍳  1️⃣ Add the cherry tomatoes, diced onion, corn, garlic, and chicken breasts to a large baking dish. Place the block of feta in the center, drizzle everything with olive oil, then season with salt, pepper, paprika, and oregano. 2️⃣ Bake at 350°F (180°C) for 35–40 minutes, or until the chicken is fully cooked and reaches 165°F (75°C) internally. 3️⃣ While everything is baking, cook your jasmine rice according to the package directions. 4️⃣ Remove the baking dish from the oven. Shred the chicken, then mash the feta and tomatoes and mix everything together until you have a creamy sauce. 5️⃣ Add 400g of your cooked rice and mix until the rice and chicken are completely coated in the feta and tomato sauce. 6️⃣ Top with grated Parmesan and fresh basil, then place back in the oven for another 10 minutes. 7️⃣ Take it out, let it cool for a few minutes, portion into 6 servings, and enjoy! Creamy, cheesy, loaded with chicken, and you’ve got 6 high-protein meals ready to go. Doesn’t get much easier than that. 🔥 Drop a like and follow for more high protein, macro friendly recipes.
